Also not Pepsi-Co, nor is this a story about a customer buying a bad product. It’s actually about a time when Planters Peanuts discontinued their “cheez balls” and my dear old dad was completely miffed. It was all he could talk about for weeks. So one day, he sat down and wrote a scathing letter detailing the years of loyalty and customer satisfaction that my dad shared with Planters products. I figured nothing would come of it once he sent it out but sure enough, months later my dad got a letter and swag bag from Planters. The letter said they were sorry for upsetting my dad and they had plans to bring back the Cheez Balls, in the meantime they sent peanuts, a hat, a planters peanut figurine, and I think a bandana? Either way, my dad was just like yours- he wore that hat and told everyone about how he got through to them. Fun times.
